Join to apply for the Security Software Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

This is a general track for security-focused engineering in every team at Canonical, across all levels of seniority. Apply here if you are already an exceptional security-focused software engineer.
Most product engineering teams at Canonical include one or two spaces for dedicated security-oriented software engineers. Their role is to challenge the entire team to think more deeply about security. They contribute to the product as engineers too, but their primary focus is to improve security through state of the art practices - from table-top threat model exercises to architecture reviews, from extended security testing with fuzzers and static analysis tools to external security analyst liaison.
We also build a number of products that are entirely motivated by security technology and requirements, such as our AppArmor kernel investments and our hardening, compliance and certification toolkits for Ubuntu.
As the publisher of Ubuntu we also handle long-term security response and hardening for the entire operating system and open source universe. Working with tens of thousands of upstreams means that we need to be fluent in every major programming language, and design, build and adopt sophisticated tools that enable us to work at scale and speed with confidence.
These roles encompass all aspects of product security, including feature development, vulnerability response, proactive security and open source community participation. All security roles interact closely with many of the other Canonical engineering and development teams, Canonical customers and our partners across the open source community.
Location: We have open roles for security specialist software engineers in every timezone.
What you'll do
Security roles might tackle any of the following:

  • Define, implement and document new security features
  • Lead security-oriented thinking in a product engineering team
  • Analyze, fix, and test vulnerabilities in Canonical and open source Software
  • Contribute to Ubuntu and upstream projects to benefit the community
  • Audit and analyze source code for vulnerabilities
  • Integrate new tools in our security infrastructure, pipelines and processes
  • Achieve and retain various security certifications
  • Extend and enhance Linux cryptographic components - specifically with modules such as OpenSSL/Libgcrypt - with the features and functionality required for country-specific compliance such as FIPS and CC certification
  • Work with external partners to develop CIS benchmarks
  • Design and develop hardening automation for Ubuntu
  • Monitor the security industry for new developments
  • Develop, test and maintain new software capabilities
  • Provide guidance and support to other engineering teams
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • A thorough understanding of the common categories of security vulnerabilities
  • Modern engineering techniques to find and fix them
  • Familiarity with open source development tools and methodologies
  • Skill in one or more of C, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Ruby or PHP
  • Experience as a security champion
  • Experience driving security within a wider SDLC process
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Optional skills we also value
  • Clear and effective communication with the team and Ubuntu community members
  • Experience working with Linux Kernel
  • Security Certification experience and knowledge in FIPS and/or CC
  • Experience with OVAL (Open Vulnerability Assessment Language)
  • Knowledge of and familiarity with low-level Linux cryptography APIs
  • Demonstrated high learning ability
  • Performance engineering experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  • The Technician is responsible for executing maintenance and preservation tasks efficiently and safely to ensure the reliability and longevity of equipment. This role involves performing a variety of maintenance and preservation activities, including but not limited to cleaning, housekeeping, blasting, spraying/painting, isolation and reinstatement, greasing application, and the preservation of topside items like flanges, bolts, and valves.
  • The technician is also responsible for ensuring that his supervisor is made aware of all activities according to procedure, especially when safety is an issue.
  • The technician/operator will demonstrate exemplary safety awareness and technical competence in all aspects of maintenance and preservation work on and around the vessel.

Authority

  • The Electrical Technician is authorized to perform activities as per the level of Electrical Authorization granted by the UEA or Fleet Electrical Assessor.

Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards

  • Maintain and adjust the condition of electrical assets:
  • Comply with relevant authorization procedures, safe working practices, and specific instructions.
  • Complete maintenance and preservation in an agreed timescale, using safe and appropriate methods and agreed procedures.
  • Ensure resources and spares are planned for and used cost-effectively.
  • Ensure the correct, current operating requirements are available for reference.
  • Ensure any assets which have been maintained or had parameters adjusted still comply with specified operating requirements with minimum disruption and with the specified methods, tools, and materials.
  • Monitor and record any maintenance or adjustments accurately in work history in MMS.

Monitor And Assess the Performance And Condition Of Electrical Assets

  • Obtain information or parameters from reliable sources (inspection ports, connections, vendor documentary information, instrument readings, diagnostic equipment) using approved methods.
  • Use monitoring equipment or procedures correctly to assess the condition of electrical assets.
  • Ensure monitoring and checks are carried out in line with specified MMS timescales and schedules.
  • Record and communicate monitored outcomes accurately and in a timely fashion to raise the effectiveness of MMS.
  • Compare current performance with previous assessments and act where differences must be addressed.

Diagnose Faults in Electrical Assets

  • Respond promptly to problems in line with approved procedures.
  • Select appropriate tests and diagnostic procedures and apply them methodically.
  • Determine the cause, nature, and extent of problems in the performance and condition of electrical systems or assets.
  • Use the results of inspections to determine the appropriate actions to take.
  • Record an accurate and full description in the appropriate document history.

Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures

  • Sample and check that controlled process discharges from the area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits.
  • Identify and halt unplanned discharges where possible, and report immediately according to policy, procedure, and regulation.
  • Ensure equipment, waste, or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
  • Ensure resources such as PPE, materials, tools, and spares are accounted for and not wasted or used inefficiently.

Join to apply for the Executive Assistant / Corporate Administrator role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Executive Assistants and Corporate Administrators to join our Corporate Operations team. We ensure that the business runs smoothly and that travel, expenses and events are efficiently and correctly managed.
We look for positive team players who are self-driven and results oriented, with excellent attention to detail. The best candidates show that they are forward planners, reliable and determined, and keen to assume responsibility for projects, processes and policy. We are a unique global business, so we are not looking for candidates with extensive experience so much as excellent organisers and communicators who are keen to develop skills and strive for continuous improvement.
This team plays a crucial role in the overall operation of the business. They run significant business operations and processes, supporting the respective department leads but also taking central responsibility for logistics, expenses, travel and scheduling. They are the secret to our success! We look for confident and effective people who have good judgment and the self-assurance to hold firm on a point of policy regardless of the seniority of people on the other side of a discussion. If you like to take responsibility and you like to ensure that things are done properly and efficiently then you will enjoy the role tremendously.
Location: This is a global operation, we have open roles in teams in all time zones.
Responsibilities

  • Support operations for one or more departments in the company
  • Coordinate monthly reports and schedule meetings and interviews
  • Organise and run international company events including logistics
  • Manage quarterly and annual executive meetings
  • Collaborate across teams on activities and initiatives
  • Manage suppliers and stakeholders
What we are looking for in you
  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • A degree in a business or technical subject
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Responsibility, integrity and accountability
  • Self-awareness and thoughtfulness
  • Ability to travel up to four times a year for company events of up to two weeks duration
  • Ability to learn new technology and software quickly
Additional Skills We Value
  • Experience in operations and executive support
  • Project management experience
  • Event related experience
  • Travel industry experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

O Grupo FQM é uma empresa da Indústria Farmacêutica que atua há 93 anos no Brasil (desde 1932), faz parte do Grupo Roemmers, multinacional com sede na Argentina, posicionado entre os cinco maiores grupos farmacêuticos da América Latina. No Brasil, a FQM ocupa a 12ª posição do ranking da Indústria Farmacêutica com faturamento acima de 2 bilhões de reais ao ano. Com um amplo portfólio de medicamentos, suplementos, cosméticos atua em 02 segmentos: Medicamentos de prescrição médica (RX) em diversas especialidades terapêuticas, e consumo (OTC) produtos para o autocuidado, isentos de prescrição médica, destinados diretamente ao consumidor final.

A FQM, com mais de 1500 colaboradores, vem escrevendo sua história através de constante aprimoramento do seu portfólio de produtos e processos e da busca incessante pela inovação e excelência para atender às necessidades do mercado farmacêutico no país, promovendo Saúde, Autoestima, Bem-estar e Qualidade de Vida à toda população.

Local de base: Escritório O2 Offices, Barra da Tijuca – Rio de Janeiro

Principais desafios:

title: Portfolio Analyst
description:
Descrição da empresa

With over 6,000 employees in more than 20 countries, Statkraft is one of the leaders in hydropower internationally and the largest generator of renewable energy in Europe. The Norwegian group produces hydropower, wind power, solar power, gas-fired power, and provides district heating.

With actions guided by ethics and transparency, the company is headquartered in the city of Florianópolis, Santa Catarina (SC). Currently, it controls 26 renewable generation assets in Brazil. In November 2023, Statkraft signed the purchase of Enerfín, the renewable subsidiary of the Spanish company Elecnor, which includes nine operational wind farms in the states of Rio Grande do Sul and Rio Grande do Norte. Thus, the company became one of the largest wind power generators in Brazil, surpassing the mark of 2.2 GW of installed capacity, including acquisitions, constructions, and operations in the country.

The company is a pioneer in offering traceable renewable energy with a guarantee of origin in Brazil, certifying, through the I-REC (International Renewable Energy Certificate), the origin of its energy production, ensuring that the operation is sustainable.

Descrição do emprego

We are looking for someone who can lead the development and the implementation of portfolio tools for the Asset book, andsupport and propose commercial strategies for the asset portfolio, taking into consideration the expansion of the asset fleet (greenfield and M&A projects) also as R2M opportunities.

As parte of this role, you will also:

  • Develop, improve and maintain the modelling of portfolio tools for the Asset book;
  • Propose and assess commercial strategies for the asset portfolio, focusing on long-term value creation and risk mitigation aspects;
  • Support Energy Management team on suggesting commercial strategies for maturities up to Y+5;
  • Assess the impact of Greenfield and M&A projects on the asset portfolio, including base case and sensitivities scenarios;
  • Support BD and M&A teams on the related processes;
  • Estimate the impact of R2M opportunities (LT PPAs, self-productions, etc) on the asset portfolio, taking into consideration updated market inputs from commercial teams (Trading and Origination);
  • Liaise closely with the risk department on P&L estimations and risk measurement for the Assets portfolio.

Qualificações

  • Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Economy or Business Administration;
  • Post Graduation in engineering or economics;
  • Solid experience in the electricity sector in Brazil;
  • Experience in portfolio management;
  • Knowledge in Risk Analysis and R / Python coding;
  • Fluent English and Portuguese.

This post is a limited-term fixed-term post.

1. Organizational context

a. Organizational Setting

The post is located in the WIPO Brazil Office (WBO).

The WBO is part of a network of WIPO External Offices that add clear value, efficiency and effectiveness to the delivery of WIPO’s programs, in line with its Strategic Goals and Results Framework, in a coordinated and complimentary way with WIPO Headquarters.

The WBO assists the Brazilian government, IP professionals, creators, innovators, businesses and communities in Brazil create value from IP through the use of WIPO treaties, services and global databases, platforms, tools, and products, as well as through the design and implementation of impactful projects and initiatives on the ground. title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.
Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.
Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.
“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.
Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.
Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.
“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

title: Reservoir Engineer
description:
The position involves supporting all reservoir engineering activities, including oil and gas reserve estimation, production forecasting, reservoir simulation, and production optimization, while also demonstrating an understanding of geoscience concepts, drilling, completions, and production operations.

• Expert in integrated reservoir simulation studies, including data analysis and integration, model construction, history matching, calibration and predictions.

• Utilize reservoir management standards and guidelines to enhance both NPV and hydrocarbon recovery.

• Competent in the analysis of capillary pressure, relative permeability and PVT data.

• Competent in compositional reservoir modeling.

• Participate in integrated field reviews and field development plans.

• Evaluates and initiates exploitation opportunities, including new drilling and work-overs to maximize reserves recovery and booking, and overall play economics.

• Prepare data and perform PTA interpretation and modeling.

• Formulate the strategies for reservoir development, data acquisition, field surveillance and monitor masterplans to ensure optimal development and depletion strategies.

• Extensive working knowledge of standard vendor applications for pre and post-processing of simulation data and Assisted History Matching software and workflows.

• Is familiar with field production activities to effectively implement reservoir management aspects during the field production phase, including liaison with regulatory agencies.

• Develop Life of Field production profiles and maintain auditable booked reserves estimates and reserves reports

• Coordinate and integrate data, simulation and studies between Artificial lift, production, and dynamic modeling to support the other areas.

• Work with the Production Engineer/Technologist to optimize well potentials.

• Write concise reports for all studies and maintain comprehensive, accessible and up-to-date records of input and interpreted data.

• Coordinates with the business development on acquisition and divestiture projects. Supports the reservoir engineering evaluation component of company acquisition


Education

• Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Petroleum Engineering.

• Long relevant experience may compensate for formal education

Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience with reservoir engineering within the oil and gas industry.

• Reservoir engineering, reservoir management and reservoir simulation skills are essential.

• Proven track record in performing reservoir modeling and field development studies.

• Pressure transient analysis (PTA) interpretation experience will be a plus.
Knowledge

• High proficiency in any reservoir simulation software (Eclipse or T-Nav preferred)

• Proficiency in any production software like Pipesim and/or Prosper.

• Experience with any pressure transient analysis software like Kappa or Pansystem.

Join to apply for the Supervisor de Construção role at PRIO

Job Description

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Estamos buscando um Supervisor de Construção para atuar em nossa operação, responsável por estabelecer e coordenar a execução dos planos e atividades de construção, com base nos equipamentos, ferramentas e instalações nas rotinas estabelecidas.

Responsibilities and assignments

  • Gerenciar o planejamento e coordenação de todos os fornecedores e prestadores de serviços que realizam trabalhos no ativo, bem como o diligenciamento das interfaces entre os escopos de projeto e de bordo;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os Superintendentes / OIM offshore para auxiliá-los na coordenação das atividades de manutenção;
  • Garantir que os padrões de construção e manutenção e os procedimentos operacionais padrão da Empresa sejam adotados e cumpridos;
  • Suporte à Engenharia de Instalações e Projetos no desenvolvimento de diferentes projetos e atividades, como construção, instrumentação, inspeções, calibrações, certificações, MOCs, JSAs (Análise de riscos de trabalho), para garantir que todos os aspectos operacionais sejam incorporados no plano de mobilização e execução dos contratados;
  • Liderar a execução das tarefas de construção e reparo de equipamentos e tubulações da Unidade Marítima;
  • Mobilizar os recursos necessários para execução dos serviços de construção e reparos;
  • Emitir/requisitar e acompanhar as permissões de trabalho;
  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir a política de Qualidade, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Saúde da empresa;
  • Estar ciente de papéis e responsabilidades em relação à resposta de emergência.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Ensino Superior completo;
  • Vivência prévia offshore;
  • Gestão de equipe de construção.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos que preencha alguns testes na etapa de cadastro para avaliarmos seu Match com nossa Cultura. Depois, nossa equipe de RH marcará uma conversa para aprofundar suas experiências, alinhando seu perfil às necessidades da vaga e à cultura da PRIO. Também falaremos sobre a companhia, benefícios e responderemos suas dúvidas. Em seguida, haverá uma entrevista técnica ou com o gestor da vaga, e os finalistas conversarão com o diretor da área para a decisão final.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e setor de óleo e gás;
  • Atualize-se sobre notícias recentes da empresa;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre trabalhar na PRIO;
  • Pense na sua história e realizações, estruturando seus resultados para compartilhar na entrevista. Seja transparente sobre sucessos e aprendizados com insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil, focada na otimização de processos, gestão de ativos e segurança. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é dinâmico, com oportunidades de crescimento e participação em projetos diversos, promovendo desenvolvimento profissional e uma cultura de alto desempenho.

HR Professional | Passionate about Culture, Growth & People

Who We Are

ENG (engbim.com) is a BIM company that specializes in hands-on, field-focused BIM services. Founded in 2007, we have positioned ourselves as the largest and most experienced BIM production service provider in the United States, having completed 5,000 BIM projects with a dedicated team of over 600 staff members. We provide MEP Modeling, VDC/BIM Management, Laser Scanning, and Scan to BIM services, as well as a comprehensive array of BIM production services to architects, engineers, and owners.

The Role

The BIM Specialist role generally involves covering the modeling of different trades (MEP), depending on your background and expertise, whose extent will depend on the scope of the project (specific zones or entire buildings), and whose quality will go according to clients’ requirements and the services provided by the team you end up joining. This position requires a high level of modeling quality (expertise, technical knowledge, LOD and QAQC capabilities), and more autonomy in its self-management and modeling capabilities (studying whatever's necessary according to each trade). A BIM Specialist saves the client problems, detecting possible conflicts throughout the initial information review and the modeling and coordination phases.

Minimum mandatory requirements include:

  • An excellent level of English is an absolute must, both spoken and written . Aspiring candidates must be able to keep up with fluent conversations both with native and non-native speakers. Candidates without this requirement will NOT be considered .
  • Solid experience modeling HVAC and plumbing in Revit for commercial, industrial, healthcare, and residential construction . This can include things like process piping , ductwork and sheet metal , and mechanical equipment (pumps , AHUs , RTUs , chillers and boilers ), and for plumbing, domestic water , sanitary drainage and gray water , stormwater , medical gases , compressed air lines , pumps , heaters and hangers .
  • Experience coordinating or clash-detecting through Navisworks (Revizto can also be considered but Navisworks will be prioritized), knowledge of BIM coordination, clash report , QAQC and model accuracy .
  • A mechanical or civil engineering bachelors degree (architects could be considered but only if they have extensive experience modeling and coordinating MEP trades themselves).

Specific requirements will vary depending on the position and service. Experience with Level Of Detail (LOD) 400 and projects based in the US , or constructability knowledge related to that country will be a huge differential . Other desirable requirements are:

  • Familiarity with BIM add-ins (e.g., Evolve , SysQue , Fabrication Parts ).
  • Experience in conceptual design / BIM Design assist.
  • AutoCAD Plant 3D knowledge.
  • Dynamo/Python knowledge applied to BIM .
  • On-site/field experience .
  • Ability to produce detailed models, including real-world fittings and connection types .

Please know if you don't have experience working with Revit in formal jobs, it will be hard to consider your profile. Please DON'T apply if you don't have the necessary English level.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- ML Infrastructure Support and Development: Build and maintain scalable ML infrastructure on Databricks, leveraging Unity Catalog and feature stores to support model development and deployment;

- Monitoring & Optimization: Build tools for model performance monitoring, operational analytics, and drift mitigation, ensuring reliable operation in production environments.
MUST HAVES
- 3+ years in MLOps, ML Engineering, Data Engineering or related roles, focusing on deploying and managing ML workflows in production environments;
- 5+ years of experience using Python ;
- Proficient in using Databricks (2-3 years), Apache Spark, ML Flow, Unity Catalog, and feature stores;
- Familiarity with ML lifecycle tools such as MLflow , Kubeflow , and Airflow ;
- Strong knowledge of Git workflows, CI/CD practices, and tools like GitLab or similar;
- Strong understanding of model performance monitoring, drift detection, and retraining workflows;
- Upper-Intermediate English level.

description:
Grupo EP Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Grupo EP Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Estamos Muito Felizes Com o Seu Interesse Em Embarcar Em Uma Jornada Com Propósito Na EP. Antes De Tudo, Queremos Que Você Conheça Um Pouco Mais Sobre Quem Somos e o Impacto Que Geramos
Oferecemos soluções ambientais personalizadas com expertise técnica superior, através de tecnologias avançadas e transparência no relacionamento com clientes. Nosso objetivo é garantir sustentabilidade e resultados de qualidade , atendendo às demandas ambientais mais desafiadoras.
Com mais de 50 anos de existência, estamos entre as 5 maiores empresas em tratamento de água e análises ambientais no país.
Já ajudamos nossos clientes a tratarem mais de 700 milhões de m³ de efluentes — o equivalente ao consumo anual de água de 12 milhões de pessoas (toda a população do Estado de SP).
Contamos com mais de 500 colaboradores , atuando em 5 frentes especializadas : Analítica, Engenharia, Equipamentos, Química e Tech.
Nosso objetivo é claro: expandir nossa atuação em todo o Brasil até 2033 .
Nossos valores
Paixão por aprender
Valorizamos e investimos no crescimento do nosso time. Acreditamos que conhecimento é nosso maior ativo — por isso, oferecemos acesso a cursos, formações e subsídios educacionais.
Falo e faço
Aqui, a coerência entre discurso e prática é essencial. Transparência, ética e responsabilidade norteiam nosso relacionamento com clientes, parceiros e colegas.
Visto a camisa
Estamos em busca de pessoas comprometidas, que se conectem com nosso propósito e tenham orgulho de fazer parte dessa transformação ambiental.
Hoje melhor que ontem
Acreditamos no poder da melhoria contínua. Pequenas evoluções diárias nos tornam uma empresa melhor e mais relevante para o mundo.
Se você também é #MOVIDOAAGUA e deseja fazer a diferença com o seu trabalho, vem com a gente!
Missão do cargo: As operações terceirizadas tem como responsabilidade garantir o perfeito funcionamento das estações de tratamento do nosso cliente, a fim de não poluir o meio ambiente, atendendo as legislações ambientais e oferecendo água de qualidade para uso em processos internos, quando necessário.
Como Será Seu Dia a Dia
Atuar na área operacional de estações de tratamentos de água e efluentes (industriais e domésticos) e reuso de água, mantendo em perfeito funcionamento;
Realizar monitoramento dos volumes dos tanques;
Realizar leitura de temperatura, pH, turbidez, Resíduos Sedimentáveis e Sedimentabilidade do lodo, de acordo com os procedimentos internos;
Preparar e repor produtos químicos inerentes ao processo de tratamento;
Preencher planilhas de controle – trabalho diário e controle de qualidade;
Verificar indicadores de funcionamento;
Operar e realizar pequenas manutenções em equipamentos pertinentes à área;
Controlar e organizar o estoque de reagentes, vidrarias e equipamentos do laboratório, reportando necessidades de reposição;
Realizar coleta de amostras para análise em laboratório;
Realizar análises químicas de baixa complexidade;
Prezar pela organização e manutenção do ambiente de trabalho;
Manter o ambiente limpo e organizado.
Pré-requisitos Para Essa Função
Curso Técnico em Química, Meio Ambiente ou áreas correlatas;
CRQ ativo;
Experiência mínima de 1 ano com tratamento de água/ efluentes.
O Que Esperamos De Você
Participe dos treinamentos e diálogos de segurança oferecidos;
Conserve seu local de trabalho e EPIs com limpeza e organização;
Colabore com o time no atingimento de objetivos do setor;
Realize com seu superior direto Feedbacks trimestrais;
Busque aplicar nossos valores no dia a dia dentro e fora da EP;
Comprometimento e ética junto ao time e cliente.

Salário: R$ 2098,00 + 30% de periculosidade
Jornada: 2x2
Local: Seropédica
Modalidade: Presencial

Vale-alimentação;

Convênio médico e odontológico;
Gympass;
Seguro de vida (vigência imediata);
FIES EP (subsídio para cursos);
Parcerias com faculdades.

Job Description
Nossa área de Estratégia e Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços.

Job Description
Nossa área de Estratégia e Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços.
Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay.
Somos a área de Projetos e Produtos de Transmissão. Nosso time atua na linha de frente da evolução da televisão no Brasil, trabalhando com tecnologias de ponta para garantir que a transmissão de TV aberta continue relevante, acessível e de alta qualidade para toda a população.
Hoje, temos um grande desafio – e também uma grande missão: liderar o desenvolvimento do DTV+, o novo padrão de TV digital do Brasil. O DTV+ é a próxima geração da televisão aberta no país. Ele foi idealizado para oferecer melhor qualidade de imagem e som, maior interatividade, mais acessibilidade, tudo isso com foco na inclusão digital e no acesso gratuito à informação.
Mais do que desenvolver tecnologia, estamos ajudando a redefinir a experiência da TV aberta no Brasil. E queremos fazer isso com diversidade, inclusão e colaboração — por isso, estamos sempre em busca de talentos que queiram construir o futuro com a gente.
Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.
Acreditamos na intencionalidade para gerar movimentos transformadores, que reconheçam que diferentes grupos sociais partem de diferentes realidades que precisam ser levadas em consideração e acolhidas pelas pessoas e pelo negócio.
Equipes representativas trazem inovação inclusiva, nos permitindo criar experiências emocionantes para diferentes tipos de pessoas.
Queremos ser cada vez mais o lugar onde todas as pessoas se encontram e, por isso, essa vaga é para você, mulher , que quer crescer e construir o futuro com a gente, nos bastidores de produtos e serviços que impactam a vida de milhões de brasileiros e brasileiras todos os dias.
Responsibilities and assignments
Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Ser responsável por definir, priorizar e manter o backlog do produto, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor;
  • Atuar como ponte entre áreas técnicas, de negócio e stakeholders externos, traduzindo necessidades em histórias claras e bem definidas para o time de desenvolvimento;
  • Fazer uso das práticas ágeis do e o uso eficaz de ferramentas como Jira e Confluence;
  • Apresentar e comunicar resultados e roadmaps do produto de forma clara e visual, utilizando PowerPoint e outros recursos de apresentação;
  • Acompanhar tendências tecnológicas em telecomunicações, eletrônica e TV digital, promovendo inovação contínua no desenvolvimento dos receptores DTV+;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com o time técnico (desenvolvedores, engenheiros, testers), promovendo decisões de produto baseadas em dados, testes e evidências;
  • Contribuir ativamente com a evolução estratégica do produto, garantindo aderência aos requisitos técnicos do padrão DTV+.

Requirements And Qualifications
Do que você precisa:
  • Formação superior completa em: Tecnologia de Telecomunicações, Eletrônica, Sistemas Embarcados, Desenvolvimento de Software, ou áreas correlacionadas;
  • Experiência como Product Owner em ambientes ágeis;
  • Conhecimento e prática com metodologias como Scrum ou Kanban;
  • Fluência em inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação);
  • Domínio das ferramentas ágeis: Jira, Confluence;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Habilidade em preparar apresentações claras e objetivas (PowerPoint).

Conhecimentos que te destacam:
  • Vivência em projetos relacionados a radiodifusão, TV digital;
  • Experiência na indústria de Mídias e Streaming e/ou indústria de televisores e eletrônicos.

Desde 2021, levamos produtos inovadores para o ecossistema do Grupo Energisa (empresa, clientes e fornecedores).

  • Comunicar resultados e promover o alinhamento com stakeholders.
  • Identificar e propor melhorias em processos, fluxos e práticas da área.
  • Acompanhar tendências e inovações relevantes, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua do time e do produto.
  • Executar outras atividades relacionadas, conforme necessidade do time ou orientação da liderança.

Para essa posição, esperamos que você tenha:

  • Vivência prática com JIRA e Azure DevOps para organização de backlog, acompanhamento de sprints, definição de tarefas e alinhamento entre squads de Produto e Tecnologia.
  • Experiência no uso do Figma em parceria com times de Design para análise de protótipos, validação de fluxos e cocriação de soluções centradas no usuário.
  • Atuação em ambientes ágeis com Scrum e Kanban , participando ativamente de cerimônias como planning, daily, review e retrospectiva, garantindo entregas incrementais e melhoria contínua.
  • Capacidade de interpretar métricas e gerar insights para embasar decisões estratégicas. Conhecimento em definição e acompanhamento de KPIs , análise de comportamento do usuário, funis de conversão, jornada do cliente e uso de ferramentas como Google Analytics para monitoramento de performance e resultados do negócio.

Como a fintech do Grupo Energisa, nascemos em 2020 com o propósito de acelerar a inclusão financeira e digital de pessoas em todo o Brasil , levando soluções, como nossa conta digital gratuita, a clientes das áreas de concessão Energisa.

Em pouco tempo, criamos produtos relevantes. Um deles é o Fique Ligado, em que clientes da Energisa negociam suas faturas atrasadas diretamente com a Voltz. Outro exemplo é a Antecipação de Recebíveis para fornecedores da Energisa. Desde que o produto foi lançado, já são quase 1 bilhão de reais em antecipações.

Nossa missão é expandir as soluções, desenvolvidas inicialmente para a Energisa, para outras utilities que enfrentam desafios complementares e semelhantes aos do grupo.

  • Monitorar desempenho e promover ciclos de melhoria contínua, utilizando PDCA e DMAIC.

Estamos construindo o maior parque termelétrico a gás natural da América Latina, localizado no Porto do Açu, um dos principais complexos portuários do Brasil, que oferece soluções logísticas para o mercado de óleo e gás brasileiro.

O projeto atual inclui a implantação de duas usinas termelétricas movidas a gás natural (GNA I e GNA II), com capacidade de gerar 3 GW de energia, suficiente para atender cerca de 14 milhões de residências. Além disso, contempla um terminal de regaseificação de GNL de 21 milhões m³/d.

Valorizamos a diversidade e trabalhamos para tornar nosso ambiente de trabalho cada vez mais inclusivo e diverso. Acreditamos que a pluralidade beneficia a todos e traz novas possibilidades ao negócio. Procuramos pessoas que se identifiquem com nossos valores e compartilhem nosso propósito.

  • Provide timely and accurate information to site teams and project managers.
  • Follow a Monday to Saturday work schedule consistent with project-based industry norms.

  • Diploma in Architecture or Civil Engineering (3 years).
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience as a BIM Modeler in GCC countries.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Revit and AutoCAD .
  • Advanced knowledge of BIM fundamentals, principles, and workflows.
  • Experience working in a collaborative shared environment.
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Proficiency with Navisworks and/or Revizto .
  • Advanced skills in MS Office and Adobe Acrobat.

Seu objetivo será identificar e qualificar oportunidades, buscando ampliar a base de clientes de minimercado em condomínios. Trabalhando em estreita colaboração com a equipe de vendas, você será o primeiro ponto de contato entre a Roda e os potenciais leads. Sua missão é identificar as necessidades dos clientes e garantir que sejam devidamente encaminhadas ao departamento de vendas para fechamento de negócios.
Responsabilidades

  • Pesquisar e identificar leads potenciais por meio de diversas fontes, como redes sociais, sites de empresas, bases de dados, eventos, etc.
  • Realizar abordagens proativas, por telefone, e-mail ou outros meios de comunicação, para apresentar nossos serviços e produtos aos clientes em potencial.
  • Agendar reuniões e observar para a equipe de vendas com leads protegidos.
  • Manter e atualizar regularmente o CRM (Pipedrive) com informações precisas sobre os prospects e as atividades de prospecção.
  • Colabore com a equipe de marketing e vendas para otimizar estratégias de geração de leads e conversão.
  • Mantenha-se atualizado sobre os produtos e serviços oferecidos pelo minimercado;
  • Contribuir para o crescimento geral do minimercado através de metas de vendas definidas.
Habilidades Necessárias
  • Experiência prévia em vendas, preferencialmente em pesquisa e prospecção de leads; ou telemarketing;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Capacidade de compreender as necessidades dos prospects e articular claramente os benefícios de nossos produtos e serviços;
  • Organização e habilidades de gerenciamento de tempo;
  • Capacidade de persuasão e negociação;
  • Boa compreensão do ciclo de vendas;
  • Persistência e força para superar objeções;
  • Conhecimento básico de ferramentas de CRM e habilidades básicas de gerenciamento de dados;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe.
Requisitos
  • Ensino médio completo (superior será um diferencial);
  • Experiência anterior em vendas ou atendimento ao cliente (desejável);
  • Familiaridade com técnicas de prospecção e geração de leads (desejável).
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente.
  • Motivação para atingir e superar metas de prospecção e conversão.
Diferenciais
  • Formação acadêmica em áreas relacionadas às vendas ou marketing;
  • Experiência prévia em prospecção B2B;
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de vendas consultivas;
  • Experiência em trabalhar com metas e prazos.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas modernas de prospecção, como cold e-mails, cold call, social selling, entre outros.
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de negociação e fechamento de negócios.
  • Capacidade de analisar o desempenho de vendas e propor melhorias.
  • Experiência com startups;
  • Experiência com PaP;
  • Experiência com vendas para prédios (relacionamento com síndico).
Processo Seletivo
O processo seletivo consistirá em etapas como análise curricular, entrevistas individuais, testes de habilidades específicas e dinâmicas em grupo, caso necessário.

title: South Region QEHS Manager
description:
Press Tab to Move to Skip to Content Link

Select how often (in days) to receive an alert:

Job Category: Support Functions

South Region QEHS Manager

Wärtsiläis a global leaderininnovativetechnologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. We emphasize innovation in sustainable technology and services to help our customers continuously improve their environmental and economic performance. Energy leads the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future. We help our partners to accelerate their decarbonization journeys through our market-leading technologies and power system modelling expertise. These cover decarbonization services, future-fuel enabled balancing power plants, hybrid solutions, energy storage and optimization technology, including the GEMS Digital Energy Platform.

Did you know Wärtsilä has delivered 79 GW of power plant capacity and more than 130 energy storage installations in 180 countries around the world?

In this fast-changing world of energy, we are constantly on the lookout for future-oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services - together. Want to join the ride?

We are looking for a QEHS Manager for our Region South which includes the following countries: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Bolivia, Paraguay and Uruguay . This role leads the development and execution of health, safety, and environmental strategies to ensure compliance with regulations and promote a culture of safety and sustainability across the organization.

The role is responsible for implementing the Wärtsilä QEHS strategies, policies and programs and ensuring organizational excellence in HSEQ compliance and performance. You will be entrusted with the development of Regional Action plans and the advancement of strategic endeavors that contribute to a culture of safety, the reduction of work-related risks, and the maintenance of compliance with established safety, health, and environmental standards at every Wärtsilä site and operational sphere.

The role has 2 direct reports across multiple countries. The position will be located in one of the main locations of the Region (with a preference for location in Brazil) and report to the Americas QEHSS Director.

Key Accountabilities

  • Provides HSE oversight and support across diverse activities, including, not limited to workshops, power plants, service projects, construction sites, and office environments.
  • Leads Health, Safety & Environment activities, ensuring compliance with all local, regional, and international QEHS regulations, as well as company HSE standards
  • Strengthen safety culture by establishing, executing and reinforcing policies, procedures, behaviors, and initiatives.
  • Utilizing strong networking and influencing skills, build clear communication channels representing QEHS across all South Regional sites to a complex set of stakeholders, including the Regional Management, local and global QEHS teams.
  • Support global initiatives with local priorities and applicability, translating and implementing global HSE strategies into relevant and actionable regional plans
  • Monitors Health, Safety, Environment & Quality Performance Metrics, reporting on trends and developing action plans for performance improvement. Drives continuous improvement in Health, Safety, Environment & Quality management.
  • Collaborates with leadership and cross-functional teams to integrate Health, Safety & Environment considerations into business operations and project planning. Engages with external stakeholders, including regulatory bodies, to represent the company's Health, Safety & Environment interests and maintain positive relationships
  • Manages Health, Safety, Environment & Quality compliance, mitigating risks and overseeing adherence to all regulations and standards. Proactively updates practices based on changing regulations and ensures all products and services conform to technical specifications and standards.
  • Lead safety walkthroughs, audits, and site inspections in collaboration with operational teams
  • Spearhead regional risk assessment activities for the South Region, incorporating the identification of hazards, monitoring safety practices, and conducting job safety evaluations.
  • Leads incident investigations, ensuring thorough root cause analysis and ensures appropriate response and reporting procedures are followed.
  • Oversee regular QEHS audits and inspections across regional sites, tracking performance and implementing improvements.

Key Subject Matter Expertise

  • Environmental and Safety Regulations and principles in region
  • Customer Experience Management (CRM) Tools
  • Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001,14001,45001)
  • Quality Development (RCA, Investigation, Inspection, Supplier Development, etc.)
  • Analytical Skills (data analysis, trending, predictive analytics, AI)
  • Security (Physical Security, Travel Security, Crisis Management, Executive Protection)
  • Business Acumen. Connecting QEHS Strategy with Business Key Priorities
  • People Leadership and Development

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, or related field. Advanced degree or professional certifications (e.g., CSP, NEBOSH, ISO Lead Auditor) are significantly favored.
  • Strong experience in HSE management, preferably in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of local and international HSE regulations and standards.
  • Proven leadership experience with the ability to influence and drive changes.
  • Understanding different management systems and what is needed from a business perspective
  • Excellent communication skills, fluency in written and spoken English. Trilingual (Portuguese and Spanish) preferred.

At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job-relevant merits and abilities.
Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.

Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Our team of 18,300 professionals, in more than 230 locations in 77 countries, shape the decarbonisation transformation of our industries across the globe. Read more on .

Effective July 2025, Wartsila Brazil will implement a new hybrid work model. Most employees who live within 65 kilometres of an office will work 6 days per month in office. This model will provide our employees the flexibility of working from home, while also providing the benefits of in-person collaboration. We will be happy to provide more information during your interview process.

title: MÉDICO OFTALMOLOGISTA (GLAUCOMA) - CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO - RJ
description:
Job description

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

·diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;

·realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;

·avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;

·programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;

·ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde.

·realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.


Main responsibilities

Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.


Requirements and skills

Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina. Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Oftalmologia. Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Oftalmologista;

Especialista em Segmento Posterior com comprovante de Estagio (Fellowship) em Segmento Posterior ou Carta de Serviço ou Especialista na Área.


Additional information

  • Local de Trabalho: Benfica - RJ
  • Carga Horária: 12h semanais
  • Regime de contratação CLT
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

O Hub Digital faz parte da nossa área de Estratégia e Tecnologia, tendo papel de destaque na nossa transformação em uma empresa media tech e D2C. Wärtsiläis a global leaderininnovativetechnologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. We emphasize innovation in sustainable technology and services to help our customers continuously improve their environmental and economic performance. Energy leads the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future. We help our partners to accelerate their decarbonization journeys through our market-leading technologies and power system modelling expertise. These cover decarbonization services, future-fuel enabled balancing power plants, hybrid solutions, energy storage and optimization technology, including the GEMS Digital Energy Platform.
Did you know Wärtsilä has delivered 79 GW of power plant capacity and more than 130 energy storage installations in 180 countries around the world?
In this fast-changing world of energy, we are constantly on the lookout for future-oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services - together. Want to join the ride?
We are looking for a QEHS Manager for our Region South which includes the following countries: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Bolivia, Paraguay and Uruguay . This role leads the development and execution of health, safety, and environmental strategies to ensure compliance with regulations and promote a culture of safety and sustainability across the organization.
The role is responsible for implementing the Wärtsilä QEHS strategies, policies and programs and ensuring organizational excellence in HSEQ compliance and performance. You will be entrusted with the development of Regional Action plans and the advancement of strategic endeavors that contribute to a culture of safety, the reduction of work-related risks, and the maintenance of compliance with established safety, health, and environmental standards at every Wärtsilä site and operational sphere.
The role has 2 direct reports across multiple countries. The position will be located in one of the main locations of the Region (with a preference for location in Brazil) and report to the Americas QEHSS Director.
Key Accountabilities

  • Provides HSE oversight and support across diverse activities, including, not limited to workshops, power plants, service projects, construction sites, and office environments.
  • Leads Health, Safety & Environment activities, ensuring compliance with all local, regional, and international QEHS regulations, as well as company HSE standards
  • Strengthen safety culture by establishing, executing and reinforcing policies, procedures, behaviors, and initiatives.
  • Utilizing strong networking and influencing skills, build clear communication channels representing QEHS across all South Regional sites to a complex set of stakeholders, including the Regional Management, local and global QEHS teams.
  • Support global initiatives with local priorities and applicability, translating and implementing global HSE strategies into relevant and actionable regional plans
  • Monitors Health, Safety, Environment & Quality Performance Metrics, reporting on trends and developing action plans for performance improvement. Drives continuous improvement in Health, Safety, Environment & Quality management.
  • Collaborates with leadership and cross-functional teams to integrate Health, Safety & Environment considerations into business operations and project planning. Engages with external stakeholders, including regulatory bodies, to represent the company's Health, Safety & Environment interests and maintain positive relationships
  • Manages Health, Safety, Environment & Quality compliance, mitigating risks and overseeing adherence to all regulations and standards. Proactively updates practices based on changing regulations and ensures all products and services conform to technical specifications and standards.
  • Lead safety walkthroughs, audits, and site inspections in collaboration with operational teams
  • Spearhead regional risk assessment activities for the South Region, incorporating the identification of hazards, monitoring safety practices, and conducting job safety evaluations.
  • Leads incident investigations, ensuring thorough root cause analysis and ensures appropriate response and reporting procedures are followed.
  • Oversee regular QEHS audits and inspections across regional sites, tracking performance and implementing improvements.
Key Subject Matter Expertise
  • Environmental and Safety Regulations and principles in region
  • Customer Experience Management (CRM) Tools
  • Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001,14001,45001)
  • Quality Development (RCA, Investigation, Inspection, Supplier Development, etc.)
  • Analytical Skills (data analysis, trending, predictive analytics, AI)
  • Security (Physical Security, Travel Security, Crisis Management, Executive Protection)
  • Continuous Improvement (Lean, Six Sigma, TQM, 5S, etc.)
  • Business Acumen. Connecting QEHS Strategy with Business Key Priorities
  • People Leadership and Development
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, or related field. Advanced degree or professional certifications (e.g., CSP, NEBOSH, ISO Lead Auditor) are significantly favored.
  • Strong experience in HSE management, preferably in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of local and international HSE regulations and standards.
  • Proven leadership experience with the ability to influence and drive changes.
  • Understanding different management systems and what is needed from a business perspective
  • Excellent communication skills, fluency in written and spoken English. Trilingual (Portuguese and Spanish) preferred.

title: South Region QEHS Manager
description:
Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. We emphasize innovation in sustainable technology and services to help our customers continuously improve their environmental and economic performance. Energy leads the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future. We help our partners to accelerate their decarbonization journeys through our market-leading technologies and power system modelling expertise. These cover decarbonization services, future-fuel enabled balancing power plants, hybrid solutions, energy storage and optimization technology, including the GEMS Digital Energy Platform.

Did you know Wärtsilä has delivered 79 GW of power plant capacity and more than 130 energy storage installations in 180 countries around the world?

In this fast-changing world of energy, we are constantly on the lookout for future-oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services - together. Want to join the ride?

We are looking for a QEHS Manager for our Region South which includes the following countries: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Bolivia, Paraguay and Uruguay . This role leads the development and execution of health, safety, and environmental strategies to ensure compliance with regulations and promote a culture of safety and sustainability across the organization.

The role is responsible for implementing the Wärtsilä QEHS strategies, policies and programs and ensuring organizational excellence in HSEQ compliance and performance. You will be entrusted with the development of Regional Action plans and the advancement of strategic endeavors that contribute to a culture of safety, the reduction of work-related risks, and the maintenance of compliance with established safety, health, and environmental standards at every Wärtsilä site and operational sphere.

The role has 2 direct reports across multiple countries. The position will be located in one of the main locations of the Region (with a preference for location in Brazil) and report to the Americas QEHSS Director.

Key Accountabilities

  • Provides HSE oversight and support across diverse activities, including, not limited to workshops, power plants, service projects, construction sites, and office environments.
  • Leads Health, Safety & Environment activities, ensuring compliance with all local, regional, and international QEHS regulations, as well as company HSE standards
  • Strengthen safety culture by establishing, executing and reinforcing policies, procedures, behaviors, and initiatives.
  • Utilizing strong networking and influencing skills, build clear communication channels representing QEHS across all South Regional sites to a complex set of stakeholders, including the Regional Management, local and global QEHS teams.
  • Support global initiatives with local priorities and applicability, translating and implementing global HSE strategies into relevant and actionable regional plans
  • Monitors Health, Safety, Environment & Quality Performance Metrics, reporting on trends and developing action plans for performance improvement. Drives continuous improvement in Health, Safety, Environment & Quality management.
  • Collaborates with leadership and cross-functional teams to integrate Health, Safety & Environment considerations into business operations and project planning. Engages with external stakeholders, including regulatory bodies, to represent the company's Health, Safety & Environment interests and maintain positive relationships
  • Manages Health, Safety, Environment & Quality compliance, mitigating risks and overseeing adherence to all regulations and standards. Proactively updates practices based on changing regulations and ensures all products and services conform to technical specifications and standards.
  • Lead safety walkthroughs, audits, and site inspections in collaboration with operational teams
  • Spearhead regional risk assessment activities for the South Region, incorporating the identification of hazards, monitoring safety practices, and conducting job safety evaluations.
  • Leads incident investigations, ensuring thorough root cause analysis and ensures appropriate response and reporting procedures are followed.
  • Oversee regular QEHS audits and inspections across regional sites, tracking performance and implementing improvements.

Key Subject Matter Expertise

  • Environmental and Safety Regulations and principles in region
  • Customer Experience Management (CRM) Tools
  • Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001,14001,45001)
  • Quality Development (RCA, Investigation, Inspection, Supplier Development, etc.)
  • Analytical Skills (data analysis, trending, predictive analytics, AI)
  • Security (Physical Security, Travel Security, Crisis Management, Executive Protection)
  • Continuous Improvement (Lean, Six Sigma, TQM, 5S, etc.)
  • Business Acumen. Connecting QEHS Strategy with Business Key Priorities
  • People Leadership and Development

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, or related field. Advanced degree or professional certifications (e.g., CSP, NEBOSH, ISO Lead Auditor) are significantly favored.
  • Strong experience in HSE management, preferably in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of local and international HSE regulations and standards.
  • Proven leadership experience with the ability to influence and drive changes.
  • Understanding different management systems and what is needed from a business perspective
  • Excellent communication skills, fluency in written and spoken English. Trilingual (Portuguese and Spanish) preferred.

Last application date: 28/07/2025

At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job-relevant merits and abilities.
Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.

This is Wärtsilä

Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Our team of 18,300 professionals, in more than 230 locations in 77 countries, shape the decarbonisation transformation of our industries across the globe. Read more on .

This model will provide our employees the flexibility of working from home, while also providing the benefits of in-person collaboration. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page .

The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. To do this well, we must continuously raise the bar on software quality—without compromising developer velocity.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.

You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.

You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.

The Team You'll Work With

The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.

About You
  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills (we communicate closely with global teams on a daily basis!)
  • 5+ years of experience in an Automation Engineering role
  • Strong ability and expertise in creating automated tests in Python and Selenium
  • Strong programming expertise in one OOP language like Python, Java, JS or Go (Python preferred)
  • Understanding of CI/CD and hands on experience with building and deployment tools like CircleCI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Docker
  • Strong experience with automation design patterns, with proven experience in both backend and frontend projects
  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset
  • You are a self-starter who thrives on solving open-ended problems, not just executing Jira tickets
  • You identify patterns and recurring issues proactively and build scalable solutions to reduce future friction
  • You have a track record of advancing quality maturity by shifting QA from hands-on execution to developer enablement through self-service tooling and process improvements
  • You are passionate about mentoring junior level team members to help them grow and learn

Please note: Please submit your resume in English. This role will be hybrid in our Rio office.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.

Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 50,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page .

The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. To do this well, we must continuously raise the bar on software quality—without compromising developer velocity.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.

You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.

You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.

The Team You'll Work With

The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.

About You

  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills (we communicate closely with global teams on a daily basis!)
  • 5+ years of experience in an Automation Engineering role
  • Strong ability and expertise in creating automated tests in Python and Selenium
  • Strong programming expertise in one OOP language like Python, Java, JS or Go (Python preferred)
  • Understanding of CI/CD and hands on experience with building and deployment tools like CircleCI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Docker
  • Strong experience with automation design patterns, with proven experience in both backend and frontend projects
  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset
  • You are a self-starter who thrives on solving open-ended problems, not just executing Jira tickets
  • You identify patterns and recurring issues proactively and build scalable solutions to reduce future friction
  • You have a track record of advancing quality maturity by shifting QA from hands-on execution to developer enablement through self-service tooling and process improvements
  • You are passionate about mentoring junior level team members to help them grow and learn

Please note: Please submit your resume in English. This role will be hybrid in our Rio office.

System Software Engineer - Ubuntu Networking
